name: Tsubakisawa Shinano
source:
The gentle, positive protagonist who loves stars.

The protagonist of Natsuzora Asterism. A girl whose strong point is her bright and energetic personality. She loves her friends, school and stargazing. Her friends call her Kano. 

Her greatest worry used to be her lack of worries, but it looks like this summer will be a bit different!?
